session.title: Sleep-first absorption for Tuesday Enduro
session.purpose: Bank physical and neural recovery, advance the primary sleep opportunity toward 23:00, and arrive at Tuesday's Enduro session without residual Monday trail cost.

dose.training: No structured run, MTB, indoor bike, gym or interval session is needed today.
dose.daylight: Use 20-30 minutes of outdoor daylight and normal easy walking before late afternoon; this is normal-life movement, not a workout.
dose.caffeine: No further caffeinated drink after 11:00. Decaffeinated coffee is acceptable if it does not disrupt the wind-down routine.
dose.nap: Do not schedule a nap. If sleepiness becomes unsafe or unmanageable, use only a 15-20-minute rescue nap ending by 13:30 and report it; accept that Tuesday still requires a fresh gate.
dose.evening: Finish dinner around 18:30-19:30, pack the Enduro and ride nutrition by 20:15, stop stimulating NYSE/Nasdaq workflow and live-market monitoring by 20:30, dim lights, begin quiet wind-down by 21:15, enter a cool dark bedroom by 22:15, and use lights out around 22:40 to target sleep by 23:00.
dose.fallback: If Clayton chooses an outdoor ride today, it replaces Tuesday's key Enduro session. Do not combine Monday MTB with the Tuesday two-cycle proof.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: Removing a low-value Monday trail dose and creating an earlier, protected sleep opportunity should improve Tuesday's perception-action timing, climbing economy and repeatability more than another ride that cannot produce adaptation by the next morning.
execution_rules: Do not use low ACWR as a reason to add a fourth MTB exposure or back-to-back consequence-bearing days.
Do not add hard training after 20:00; the target adaptation tonight is sleep opportunity, not fatigue.
Front-load normal hydration through the afternoon, use ordinary salt with meals, and avoid a large fluid bolus close to bed.
Eat a familiar dinner with approximately 70-100 g carbohydrate and 30-40 g protein; avoid making it unusually late, heavy, fatty, spicy or alcoholic.
If work must continue after 20:30, record the actual work-end time rather than assuming the 23:00 target was preserved.

expected_result.sleep: Lights out by approximately 22:40, sleep near 23:00, and a materially longer primary sleep opportunity than the prior 00:10-to-07:08 window.
expected_result.physical: Normal or fresher legs and upper body Tuesday morning with no Monday training residue.
expected_result.technical: Tuesday visual scanning, braking timing, line choice and coordination begin at normal speed without compensatory concentration.
expected_result.next_day: A fresh Tuesday sync and subjective gate determine whether the written two-cycle Enduro session remains available.

stop_rules: Do not convert normal energy or favorable weather into an unplanned Monday trail session while retaining Tuesday as a key day.
If unusual sleepiness, illness, pain or cognitive impairment develops, prioritize safety and recovery and report it; Tuesday is then downshifted rather than forced.
If an outdoor ride is chosen today, cancel the Tuesday quality prescription and move the matched Enduro proof to Thursday after recovery review.
